rules.pre_failure_command: all five substeps strictly precede the first recorded physical violation
rules.diagnostic_window: starts before first violation; quality only if its complete future strictly precedes that violation
rules.right_censoring: fewer than thirty future commands remain
rules.mixed_window: proposed expert changes or withdraws within the thirty held commands
rules.prediction: prediction associated with the proposed expert, not the shuffled logical label
rules.uninfluenced_proposals: disabled or rejected proposals are counted separately and receive no prediction-error score
